# Config reference

All variables are registered with `rz_config_add_integer` on plugin load.

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Zero means |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Fr.mem.max` | `0x100000` (1048576) | max bytes per `Frx`/`Frw` | no limit |
| `Fr.timeout` | `5000` | session and agent request timeout in ms, also the remote probe bound | falls back to 5000 |
| `Fr.hw.watchpoints` | `4` | max hardware watchpoint slots `FrW` may request | agent default 4 |
| `Fr.java.max` | `512` | max loaded classes per `FrC` request, also caps batch imports | unlimited |
| `Fr.dex.max` | `0` | max runtime classes used by `FrX` | unlimited (default) |
| `Fr.ac.min` | `2` | minimum characters before class autocomplete triggers | always triggers |
| `Fr.ac.max` | `12` | max autocomplete suggestions shown | falls back to 12 |

Reading and setting:

```text
[0x00000000]> e Fr.timeout
5000
[0x00000000]> e Fr.timeout=1000
```

Values are integers. They persist for the session like any rizin config
variable and can be set from `~/.rizinrc`.
